card.title: What Really Happened?
card.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For this missing-parcel form: was it a bag or a box? You've said both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A bag, I think. I carried it by the handles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Describe the handles. Were they attached to fabric or cardboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cardboard. It had a rigid lid, too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why 'bag'? Tell me again what you carried. Was the box inside something?

mechanism: A tests a changing parcel description against concrete construction details and asks the account again.
confusable: Unlike assuming deception, A must compare evidence and leave room for an explanation that reconciles it.
comparison: Physical bag/box classification differs from the other claim's timeline and movement of a lost bag.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
